items.title: Arthur Vigne Interview, 1961-11-29
items.q: I remember that cabaret. ... I remember hearing him saying he played at Tom Anderson ... I remember those places.

ctx.x: You know what at that place? Yeah, was that the one on Rambord Street? Or did he have a couple places?
He had one on Basin Street and one on Rambord Street. He had one on Basin Street and one on Rambord Street. He used to play. Tom Anderson on Basin Street. I remember that cabaret.
In the corner of there of the Custom House in the Basin. Yeah.
